title: Cartwise Rewards Monthly Tier Evaluation
content:
On the tier's evaluation day each month, a Cartwise Rewards member's tier is set against the member's qualifying spend over the trailing 12 months.

## How the evaluation decides

**Measure.** The qualifying spend for an evaluation is the sum of the customer's order item subtotals after item refunds, excluding alcohol, fees and tips, for orders closed in the 12 calendar months ending the day before the evaluation date.

**Promotion.** A member is promoted at once to the highest tier whose minimum qualifying spend is met. Promotions take effect at the evaluation.

**Grace and downgrade.** A member below the current tier's minimum keeps it for the tier's grace period, counted in evaluations, and then drops the tier's number of tiers lost per evaluation after grace.

**Who is evaluated.** Tiers are evaluated only for accounts that are active, as the company's record of the Cartwise Rewards account shows at the evaluation.

## Evaluation window, laid out (hypothetical dates)

| Evaluation date | Orders counted: those closed from | through |
|---|---|---|
| 1 July 2026 | 1 July 2025 | 30 June 2026 |
| 1 March 2026 | 1 March 2025 | 28 February 2026 |

An order closed on the evaluation date itself falls in the next month's window, not this one.

## Outcomes by case

| Member's position at the evaluation | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Qualifying spend meets the minimum of a tier above the current one | Promoted at once, at this evaluation, to the highest tier whose minimum is met |
| Qualifying spend meets the current tier's minimum but no higher tier's | Stays on the current tier |
| Qualifying spend is below the current tier's minimum, with grace remaining | Keeps the current tier |
| Qualifying spend is below the current tier's minimum, grace used up | Drops the tier's number of tiers lost per evaluation after grace |
| Account is not active | Not evaluated |

## Hypothetical timeline

Suppose a member holds a tier whose grace is 2 evaluations and whose tiers lost per evaluation after grace is 1, and the member's qualifying spend is below that tier's minimum at the evaluations on 1 August, 1 September and 1 October (all hypothetical).

| Evaluation | Result |
|---|---|
| 1 August | Keeps the tier (first evaluation of grace) |
| 1 September | Keeps the tier (second evaluation of grace) |
| 1 October | Grace used up: drops one tier |

**Promotion that skips tiers, hypothetical.** A member at Cartwise Rewards Bronze whose qualifying spend at an evaluation meets the minimum of Cartwise Rewards Platinum but not of Cartwise Rewards Diamond is promoted at that evaluation straight to Platinum, the highest tier whose minimum is met.

## Basis Q&A

**Does a promotion wait for a later month?** No. It takes effect at the evaluation.

**How far does a member drop once grace is used up?** By the tier's number of tiers lost per evaluation after grace, counted from the current tier, at that evaluation.

**Are suspended or closed accounts evaluated?** No. Only active accounts are evaluated.
